details.description: Phi-3-vision-128k-instruct is a 4.2-billion-parameter multimodal model from Microsoft's Phi-3 family that combines an image encoder, connector and projector with the Phi-3 Mini language model so it can reason over combined image-and-text input. Microsoft released it on May 21, 2024, training it on about 500 billion vision-and-text tokens, and built it for general image understanding, optical character recognition, and chart or table analysis in memory- and latency-constrained deployments. Microsoft's Hugging Face listing for the Phi-3 family now also links to the newer Phi-3.5-vision-instruct model.
advantages: Scores 90.8 on ScienceQA, 81.4 on ChartQA, and 80.5 on MMBench, per Microsoft's model card benchmark table.
Scores 70.9 on TextVQA and 44.5 on MathVista, per the model card, reflecting document/OCR and chart-and-diagram reasoning ability.
Combines an image encoder with the Phi-3 Mini language model to handle combined image-and-text prompts, per the model card.
disadvantages: Reduced performance on non-English languages, per the model card.
Code generation support beyond Python is limited, per the model card.
Microsoft's Hugging Face page for the Phi-3 family now also links to the newer Phi-3.5-vision-instruct model.
use_cases: General image understanding and visual question answering
Multimodal tasks in memory- or latency-constrained deployments

notes: Two conflicts with the catalog facts, kept as authoritative per instructions: (1) catalog max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens is 32064, but Microsoft's model card states a 128,000-token context window -- the description avoids stating either number. (2) catalog modality is text_input/text_output only, but this model's entire purpose per the maker's own card is combined image-and-text (multimodal) input, so the description covers that functional capability (as done for other vision models in this catalog, e.g. firellava-13b, computer-use-preview) while the modality fact itself is left unrestated. Microsoft's page links to the newer Phi-3.5-vision-instruct model but does not explicitly call phi-3-vision-128k-instruct deprecated.
